objects.name: handset
objects.description: A phone a patient books and checks in from.

indexes.name: by_patient
indexes.description: Every handset one patient has used, so a lost phone can be cut off.

objects.name: one_time_code
objects.description: A code texted to a patient to confirm their number.

indexes.name: by_number
indexes.description: Finds the outstanding code for a number at check-in.

objects.name: code_failure
objects.description: Wrong-code counters, so a mistyped number cannot be hammered.

objects.name: patient_number
objects.description: Which patient record a number reaches.

objects.name: clinician_login
objects.description: A clinician's sign-in to the front-desk system.

indexes.name: by_clinician
indexes.description: Lists the logins one clinician holds.

objects.name: identity_check
objects.description: Whether a patient's identity documents have been seen at the desk.

indexes.name: by_standing
indexes.description: The desk's work queue, which reads every check still waiting.

objects.name: number_key
objects.description: The key patients' phone numbers are hashed under.

objects.name: consent
objects.description: A clinic's own object, with no role in the module: which privacy notice a patient has agreed to. Declared here to show a domain adding a table of its own rather than asking the module for a field.

fields.name: notice_version
fields.description: Which version of the notice they saw.
